title: Ryu's secret behind Sagat's scar in Street Fighter
subject: ryu
description:
Could Ryu have stopped that punch? 👇

The dark power hidden in Ryu's very first title fight, and the fan theory about Akuma. Spoilers for the Street Fighter series.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Ryu almost killed a man in his very first final.
At 23, he was losing the first World Warrior final to Sagat, the Muay Thai king.
Something cold took over, and his Metsu Shoryuken split Sagat's chest open.
That cold thing is the Satsui no Hado, the urge to win even if your opponent dies.
Gouken's brother gave in to it completely and became Akuma.
Akuma tested Ryu on Gokuentou island. When Ryu refused the power, Akuma shattered the island.
Fans believe Akuma has a simpler reason to care: he is Ryu's real father. Capcom has never confirmed it.
